status: prospective fixed exploratory plan; no tuning from study outcomes
purpose: test drift/reversal optimizer for a synthetic external service-share loss, not neural classification

model.plant: exact first-order response to held probability over each irregular observation interval

learner.gradient: OLS received loss vs stored actual clipped absolute trial score over last 256 receipts; biased surrogate, centers move at fixed updates
learner.wave: Analytic triangle at physical time; seeded block paired control. Amplitude follows previously received error.
learner.frequency: 1 / (8 * max(state_tau, feedback_delay, error_ema_tau)) for time-scaled arms

metrics: seeds with lower final loss than paired/fixed baselines

criteria.success: Primary error_time_8 lower mean final error than paired and fixed overall and in at least3/4 cases; error_time_4/16 exploratory only, no winner substitution
criteria.limits: small exploratory comparison; identical gain is not per-method hyperparameter optimization; no statistical superiority or neural claim

units: state_tau, feedback_delay, periods, EMA tau and origin/receipt timestamps are physical-time units; update schedule and window length use observation counts
noise_seed_rule: Random(7000 + case_index*100 + seed), same complete noise vector for all arms
receipt_order: Process due receipts in increasing observation ID order before each tick. Loss belongs to tagged origin trial. No flush after observation2048.
analysis_limits: Shared update counts do not remove phase lag, moving-center/endogenous-regressor bias, overlapping-window correlation, or stale target-shift observations. No unbiased gradient or neural efficacy claim.
